paragraphs: Shashna. Rav Dimi bar Shashna. [Gittin 62a (Hyman cites 62b)](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.62a.11).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gittin names Rav Dimi bar Shishna transmitting in Rav’s name, as does [Menachot 90a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.90a.13). [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=915&lang=en) cites both passages with the spelling ששנא, as in Hyman.
Shashna is a conventional vocalization of ששנא, listed in Rav Dimi bar Shashna. The title רב is explicit; this parent-name listing does not provide further identification.
